description: Christopher Gallant, a 36-year-old air traffic controller, Black Hawk helicopter pilot and volunteer firefighter with the Copaigue Fire Department, hadn’t planned on a career in politics. But after President Donald Trump took office last year, Mr. Gallant, who lives in Amity Harbor, said he was shocked to see Congress do…
